title: Drum Kit
creator: smoj
licenseEvidenceDescription: Original Poly Pizza model page identifies the creator and CC-BY 3.0 license and links to the Creative Commons license.
sourceVersion: No immutable upstream release or commit is published; downloaded original GLB bytes are pinned by SHA-256.
runtimeAdaptation: Reflect X, uniformly scale source units by 1.4, translate Y by 0.504, reverse triangle winding, and separate instruments by an explicit source-node and material inventory. Merge by instrument, response role and material; retain original flat colors and translucent drum surfaces. Omit the stool and carpet. Render only tagged shells and playing surfaces; remove source stands, pedals and other support hardware from render clones. Fit body width and rotation around shared kit mounts, align playing surfaces to calibrated strike heights, and align the kick body to the common shell mount. Original application stands and pedal contacts belong to a separate persistent hardware layer, independent of body replacements and hit response. Source binaries remain unmodified.
